mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu ( id, parent_id, permission_code, route_code, title_labels, icon_code, sort_order, visible, deleted ) VALUES ( #{menu.id}, #{menu.parentId}, #{menu.permissionCode}, #{menu.routeCode}, CAST(#{menu.titleLabels} AS JSONB), #{menu.iconCode}, #{menu.sortOrder}, #{menu.visible}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, route_code = #{routeCode}, title_labels = CAST(#{titleLabels} AS JSONB), icon_code = #{iconCode}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, visible = #{visible}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{menuId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0

WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{menuId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM sys_menu child JOIN menu_tree parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE child.deleted = 0 ) UPDATE sys_menu menu SET deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = menu.version + 1 WHERE menu.id IN (SELECT id FROM menu_tree)
